products.body:
Fresh, vibrant strawberries sourced directly from South Africa's premium growing regions. Each 250g pack delivers sweet, juicy berries perfect for fresh consumption, smoothies, or desserts. Hand-selected for quality and ripeness, these strawberries offer natural sweetness and are rich in vitamin C and antioxidants. Store in the refrigerator and enjoy within 3–4 days for best flavor and texture.

Usage Instructions

  • Rinse strawberries gently before serving
  • Remove the green tops if preferred
  • Serve fresh, slice into bowls, blend into smoothies, or use as dessert topping
  • Add to cakes, fruit salads, breakfast plates, pancakes, waffles, or lunchboxes

Care Instructions

  • Store strawberries in the refrigerator after delivery
  • Keep dry until ready to wash and serve
  • Avoid crushing or placing heavy items on top of the pack
  • Remove any soft or damaged berries to help protect the remaining strawberries
